description: Timestamp anything on Bitcoin with OpenTimestamps: send text, a SHA-256 hash or a URL and get a standard .ots proof (base64). Only a salted hash leaves our server. The public calendars anchor it in a Bitcoin block within hours; then btc-timestamp-verify returns the block and the complete proof, which anyone can check with the open-source ots tool. For contracts, AI outputs, datasets, invoices and web evidence. Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"text":"Contract draft v3, agreed 2026-10-11"}.
